name: sol8-focused-screenshot
goal: Fetch an explicitly selected passed focused screenshot without weakening failed-record or integrity guards

evidence: An explicit focused scenario may fetch a passed usable screenshot with its original record, bytes and hash; default selection and failed focused records remain unchanged.
The existing four download tests covered full-record selection and integrity only. Extend those cases with focused record binding, implicit refusal, failed or incomplete refusal and integrity checks.
3f97de0ce0 fails the existing download suite because an explicitly selected passed focused capture is rejected before artifact retrieval.
3a099228d9 permits only explicitly selected passed usable focused screenshots, retaining original artifact binding, full-status null and all integrity checks.
The unchanged four-case download suite passes at 3a099228d9. It refuses implicit, failed, incomplete, unusable and failed-capture focused records and retains SHA-256 rejection.
